notes.title: Completely Overhauled Version
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

After a long absence, I'm back with a big announcement.

First, a little background on why no bugs were fixed or new content added to the released version for so long. You know that VR is a fast-moving technology. The time came when Valve, whose software I used to develop the game, released a major update that meant I would have had to develop the game from scratch. Bug fixes, new content, etc. would have required me to bring the game up to date with the Valve interface. As a one-man company, I didn't have the time or money to do that.

This year, I decided to fundamentally move my developments away from a proprietary interface (Valve / SteamVR) and switch to an open interface (OpenXR). The product that emerged was "Shopkeeper Simulator: Refreshed".

[h1]What has changed[/h1]
In addition to the deeper technical changes, there are changes to the interaction system, whereby the (admittedly somewhat error-prone) notebook is replaced by the native OpenXR interaction and the tracking (gripping) problems of various headsets should be a thing of the past.
The stealing mechanic unfortunately had to be removed due to technical problems.

[h1]Notes[/h1]
This version has been tested with HTC Vive and Meta Quest 2.
The old version is still available under the legacy branch.

Have fun!

notes.title: Removal of Money Bundles and Maximum Income
notes.content:
With the latest update come two major changes. With this we are responding to many suggestions from you. Thanks to Finnick and Venturai in particular!

[H1]Bundles of money[/h1]
Apparently, the many green bundles have lost their appeal for many players and at some point lay around in the shop. Therefore, the money now disappears when put into the cash register. The income per customer is calculated as usual when finishing a customer.

https://youtu.be/Epx-RqC4dHg
[H1]Safe upgrade[/h1]
Closely related to the first point is the safe, which can be purchased as an upgrade. In order for the safe to continue to have a function, only a maximum income of 300 points can be achieved without a safe upgrade. This limit is removed when you buy the safe.

What do you think of the update?

notes.title: Thieves Update Now Live!
notes.content:
I hope you are having a good time with the game! To keep things fresh and exciting, I introduce you today to a new feature.

From now on it gets a little sneakier in your shop! [b]Some customers turn into thieves who try to steal your hard-earned money[/b]! When they see money within their reach you will see an animation and a red outline for the money they have in their sight. Their malicious attempt was successful when the animation ends. You have[b] some options to deal with this[/b]:
[list]
[*]When you look at a thief, he will retract his little hands as if nothing happened! Only to retry his theft when you look away again.
[*]Throw an item at him and see him run for his life!
[*]Be quick enough to serve him to earn cash and make the best out of the situation.
[*]Keep an eye on him all the time and wait until the timer runs out. 
[/list]

notes.title: Infinite Fun and Demanding Customers
notes.content:
In the latest update we included some improvements that we want to introduce to you.

[h1]Endless Mode[/h1]
In the new mode, which you can choose at the beginning of the game, the days are no longer limited. In this endless mode, there are no more "theme days" that dictate the demand for specific products.

There are more products in demand, so there is more variety in the game.

Demand for a product is still determined by a random factor that increases demand over time. If such a product is sold, the demand decreases again. This is intended to simulate the principle of supply and demand. Having said that, you can still play the mode with fixed days and themed days:

[img] https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32652545/c1ecb5baa60be6680b4781e7f0630b169917a50b.jpg [/img]

[h1]Customers want more [/h1]
In order to make the serving of individual customers more sophisticated and the game more realistic, some customers will now want to have several products:

[img] https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32652545/b3b5ff8c5001ce835591ccee1fbc1bc22864cdd7.jpg [/img]

You have to serve those customers fully in order to get money from them. Once an item is dropped into the bag it's gone and will only get paid for if all wanted products are given to the customer.

[h1]Tooltip Help [/h1]
The operation of the notebook and especially the scrolling of the screen is not always completely understandable. Therefore, there are now help texts that disappear after the first usage:

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32652545/65a1c91e3f784e6ec921f735f890ca8819f6f598.jpg [/img]

As usual, have fun with the update and do not forget to visit [url=https://discordapp.com/channels/482134551305519107]Discord[/url] and give us feedback :)

notes.title: Summer update with brand new UI, setting prices, and economy!
notes.content:
Since today there is the big summer update with new gameplay and interesting changes. Despite the relocation and construction site, we have tried to implement new ideas from you and are proud to provide you with new content to try out!

[*]The gameplay has fundamentally changed. There are no more levels to reach. Instead, there are working days, each lasting 8 hours (about 8 minutes in real time). During this time you have to make as much money as possible so that you can pay your rent. The excess money will be taken over to the next day so you can continue shopping for goods.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32652545/ef5f7b735c718df0e829c82f063bb2af9811056b.png[/img]

[*]You can now set your prices for each item. A purchase or sale always brings profit, but the time could be short for the standard price. Too high a price prevents customers from visiting your store!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32652545/07abeba592821fa008d1165ab4180d1642aae59a.jpg[/img]

[*]The needs of the customers is no longer coincidental, but depends on the "daily action". The contents are given, but the amount of demand is calculated.

[*]The notebook is still the control center of your business. As the information to be managed becomes more and more, we have introduced an eye control. If you look at the notebook, the screen will be zoomed out, leaving more space available. If you look away again, the screen returns to its original size.
[*]You no longer have to touch a button with your finger. It is enough to point with your index finger in the direction of the button so that it is highlighted.

We hope to make the game even more interesting and diversified for you. If you have feedback or suggestions, let us know in the comments!

notes.title: Oculus Rift, Tooltips, Fridge, Autosave And Improved Controls
notes.content:
We have new content and improvements for you!

[h1]The Fridge[/h1]
As you might know, the fridge in Shopkeeper Simulator VR had a nice door and a humming sound but no function whatsoever.

With the latest update that has changed! Keep your milk, meat, cheese and joghurt always in a cool place to avoid wasting it forever! You won't get money for decayed items from your customers!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32652545/e8ec0940292e114afa00efc6f7e1356f105391eb.jpg[/img]


[h1]Autosave[/h1]

From now on you do not have to start a new game every time you start Shopkeeper Simulator VR. We have added a button on the laptop screen that lets you exit and save the game automatically:

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32652545/3fdbd8337535bba61397404d82e2cee0c7fe28bc.jpg[/img]

The next time you start the game, you can choose a new option from the main menu:

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32652545/4f27355c170ecd9762e9124f04cc1935e122349b.jpg[/img]

[h1]Tooltip Help[/h1]
​We are trying out a new help system to help new players get started. When you hover your hand over a help icon, a panel will fade in giving you details:

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32652545/31f57674419f948fa53716691c293544a2e67249.jpg[/img]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32652545/7b80c637e41ad7f0fddd5982e54914f39579069d.jpg[/img]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32652545/c42c0cd68f97ad37f4d6b80b69f921c2873aa9d3.jpg[/img]

[h1]Support for the Oculus Rift[/h1]
Experience your shopkeeping business now on the Oculus Rift! Since the play area with 2 by 1 Meters is not too large, the Rift is able to track all your movements.

[h1]Updated VR Hands Alignment[/h1]
The VR hands should now feel more natural because they have the same orientation as the "real" hands. Grabbing and pointing with the Vive and Rift controllers feels better now!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32652545/1d3e1e6bbeb3d1aeb44a0aee15ccb4cf1d4263b5.png[/img]

[b]We also made the following improvements:[/b]
[list]
[*]Items will be snapped firmly to your hands when you pick them up
[*]Better and easier scrolling of the laptop screen
[*]Better and more realistic lighting 
[/list]
Have fun with the new update and let us know if you experience any problems!

notes.title: Update Log Until Today
notes.content:
Dear community,

first of all, I would like to thank you for your interest in Shopkeeper Simulator VR! Your support and feedback  is very important to us because it allows us to assess where the game should be going.

We would like to make our development history to the present day more transparent. That way, you may get a deeper insight how the game has developed over time and that we keep updating it constantly.

We took the complete update history from the website "itch.io" where the game was initially presented. You find the original blog on [url=https://glocksoftware.itch.io/shopkeeper-simulator-vr/devlog]itch.io[/url].


***********************

[b]April 20, 2018:] New tutorial + difficulty settings![/b]
You can now choose between 3 difficulty settings. These affect how often new customers will enter your shop. Also a new Tutorial will be displayed at the start of the game.

[b]April 18, 2018: Customer timers are here![/b]
Customers don't have all the time in the world! Serve them quickly!

[b]April 13, 2018: Version 0.4.0 brings customer queues![/b]
Hello guys!
I implemented a customer queue that scales with the difficulty setting! Easy mode is now the mode which was the default mode before, with one customer at a time. "Medium" difficulty now supports up to three customers that wait in a queue to get served by you.
I plan to improve things by adding a timer to each customer so that you get a little sweat going!

[b]April 03, 2018: Logo Redesign - New gameplay trailer[/b]
We are updating Shopkeeper Simulator VR's appearance and are putting more time into the product's presentation.  We replaced the starting logo and added new textures to the game. Check out the new gameplay trailer :)

[b]March 28, 2018: Big visual changes for Shopkeeper Simulator VR! Enjoy your store with highly detailed textures![/b]
Stay tuned, we are improving the looks of the game constantly!

[b]March 23, 2018: Cash register update![/b]
Hey shopkeepers, you can now throw around some money and operate the cash register! Open the register by smashing on the green button. There is some velocity needed to open it. Close the tray by pressing the trigger on the front of the tray! Enjoy your VR money!

[b]March 10, 2018: Shopkeeper Simulator VR ​gets some background music![/b]
New update released (0.3.3): Added some motivating music! (if it stressed you out too much, you can switch it off in the Settings menu) UI improvements Keep selling!

[b]March 09, 2018: Title screen moved![/b]
Moved the Title and Settings screen into the market.  Added some more info about leaving feedback

[b]March 01, 2018: Major update![/b]
Use your computer to order groceries!
We are proud to present a new feature in Shop Simulator VR:

You now have a laptop at your disposal which enables you to order the groceries you need! Use a swiping finger gesture as you would in real life!

[list]
[*]Added computer to order groceries
[*]Implemented finger gesture to scroll the screen
[*]Added buttons to buy selected items
[*]Switches location of refridgerator to the left which should be more comfortable
[/list]

[b]February 22, 2018: Dimmed Lights, warmer colors[/b]
Light's intensity and ambient light reduced, warmer colors, reduced file size 42 MB -> 35 MB

[b]February 21, 2018: Decoration: Shelf, lights and posters![/b]
Added ceiling light models and some more lighting, added advertisement posters and a shelf with new groceries (only decoration for now!)

[b]February 20, 2018: Fixed Left/Right hand assignment[/b]
Uploaded new version (0.1.1): Fixed a bug which caused the hand orientation to change between the start screen and the market scene. Performance optimizations Added a new animated GIF to the product page!
